Before: banana (~100 g edible, ~90 kcal), English muffin with cheese/egg (~120 g, ~300 kcal), coffee/tea (~300 ml). After: banana and muffin fully eaten; roughly half the drink remains, about 150 ml consumed.

Total: about 400 kcal. Mass eaten: 100 + 120 + 150 = 370 g.
